Reads MPIDR_EL1 and returns the cluster_id of the matching topology entry. Source: osfmk/arm64/machine_routines.c ml_get_cluster_number_local.
Returns the 32-bit field after num_cpus in topology_info (max_cpu_id). Source: osfmk/arm64/machine_routines.c ml_get_max_cpu_number.

Takes (fmt, va_list), passes them with the stripped caller address to the same formatter as printf and returns 0; order after printf and before consdebug_putc. APFS and AppleEffaceableStorage call it. Source: osfmk/kern/printf.c vprintf.

Calls the vnop_strategy descriptor (name string at the descriptor) through bp->b_vp->v_op with the 0x307a vnop discriminator; buf_vnode is inlined. Source order between VNOP_SETXATTR and filt_fsevent_process.
Clears the per-CPU SMR slot of smr->smr_pcpu (cpu number inlined from the CPU data) with a release store and re-enables preemption; between smr_enter and smr_ack_ipi.
Takes the vnode spin lock inline, sets bit 0 of the v_specinfo flags (orr #1) and unlocks; first of the pair between vnode_ismountedon and vnode_settag.
Same shape as vnode_setmountedon but clears bit 0 (and #~1); second of the pair between vnode_ismountedon and vnode_settag.
Returns the continuous (sleep-inclusive) counter register directly; follows clock_continuoustime_interval_to_deadline, which reads the same register.
Byte-wise table CRC-32 with inverted seed and result, identical loop to native crc32.
Reads 4 bytes from the per-CPU entropy provider and masks with 0x7fffffff; native random returns RandomULong() & 0x7fffffff.
Tail-calls vnode_lookupat with a NULL start directory (x4 = 0), which is the whole body of vnode_lookup.
Returns the task placed after the proc unless the proc flag P_LHASTASK is clear; same test and select as native proc_task.
Returns 0 for VBAD vnodes, otherwise kauth_authorize_action(vnode_scope, ctx->vc_ucred, action, ctx, vp, dvp, &error) and maps a denial without error to EACCES.
Caches and parses the osversion string into major<<24 | build letter<<16 | build number, falling back to 1; same parser as native cp_os_version.
Takes (lock, gate), verifies the gate tag, panics for an allocated gate, then destroys it inline (gate_destroy_internal); followed by lck_rw_gate_free in source order after lck_rw_gate_alloc_init.
Zeroes the buffer, proc_find(pid), copies at most 17 bytes of p_comm and proc_rele; between proc_parent and proc_best_name.
Defaults thread_id to the current thread id, then with preemption disabled appends (time, subsystem/code, arg) to the per-CPU ktriage buffer; same layout as native ktriage_record.
Wrapper of the fd-to-vnode helper with both optional outputs NULL: resolves the context proc, looks up the fd vnode, takes an iocount and drops the fileproc, which is vnode_getfromfd(ctx, fd, vpp).

Darwin 26 KPI: resolves the context proc like vfs_context_proc and returns p_vfs_iopolicy bit 0x20 (P_VFS_IOPOLICY_IGNORE_CONTENT_PROTECTION, same bit index as the 0x2000 ENTITLED_RESERVE_ACCESS test in vfs_context_allow_entitled_reserve_access). Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch.

Darwin 26 KPI: same shape as the previous function but tests p_vfs_iopolicy bit 0x8000, which this kernel never sets, so the native body returns false. Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch.

Darwin 26 KPI: validates (vp, offset, length, filesize, callback, arg), calls the callback (type discriminator 0x8b37 = int (*)(vnode_t, off_t x5, void *)) per 64 MiB page-aligned chunk and marks each chunk with cluster_update_state_internal(flags 0, defer writes). Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch.

Takes (lock, gate): verifies the gate tag and type bits 0x60000 of gate->gt_flags read through x1, then tries to claim the holder; gate_try_close is inlined. Reference order wrongly paired it with gate_try_close(gate), which made APFS pass the lock as the gate.

Takes (lock, gate): verifies the gate tag and type bits through x1 and closes it; gate_close is inlined. Reference order wrongly paired it with gate_close(gate): APFS lookup panicked with 'Gate used is invalid' on the lock. Follows lck_rw_gate_try_close and precedes the lck_rw_gate_open wrapper.

Returns cs_blob+0xb8, which in the Darwin 26 cs_blob is csb_teamid (cdhash grew to a 64-byte hash plus length, so every field from csb_hashtype on moved by 0x30: hashtype 0xa0, cd 0xb0, teamid 0xb8). Reference-symbol matched it to csblob_get_auxiliary_info only because native csb_auxiliary_info is also at 0xb8.
Returns cs_blob+0xe8, the Darwin 26 csb_auxiliary_info (native 0xb8 + 0x30); follows csblob_set_auxiliary_info, which stores the same field.
Returns the 32-bit field at cs_blob+0x24 (csb_signer_type, before the moved fields); identical to native.
Returns the code signing monitor trust level when csb_csm_obj is set, else -1; this kernel has no monitor and native returns -1.
Returns cs_blob+0xb0, the Darwin 26 csb_cd (native 0x80 + 0x30).
Retains the OSEntitlements object and stores it signed (discriminator 0xaa50, cs_blob.csb_entitlements) at cs_blob+0xd0 (native 0xa0 + 0x30).
Loads csb_entitlements (0xaa50) at cs_blob+0xd0, retains and returns it.
Returns the authenticated csb_entitlements (0xaa50) at cs_blob+0xd0 without retaining it.
Takes p_textvp (signed 0x612c), requires CS_SIGNED in the proc csflags and returns ubc_cs_blob_get(textvp, -1, -1, p_textoff).
Resolves the proc blob like csproc_get_blob and returns bit 0 of cs_blob+0xdc (csb_platform_binary, native 0xac + 0x30).
Checks the fileglob is a vnode, takes the vnode lock, reads the ubc info blob list and returns the first blob's csb_teamid at +0xb8.
Resolves the proc blob through p_textvp/p_textoff and ubc_cs_blob_get, then reads its platform identifier; the only native function between csvnode_get_platform_identifier and cs_entitlement_flags.
Returns the first byte of the launch constraint data; identical to native.
Under the proc lock takes p_textvp (0x612c) and a hold, then vnode_getwithref; returns the vnode with an iocount or NULL. First of the pair between proc_is_zombie and proc_gettty.
Same as proc_getexecutablevnode but skips the lock for the current proc and uses the non-blocking vnode reference; second of the pair.
Sends the key to the code signing monitor (selector 0x1a); native without a monitor stores it in the kernel. Source order after the compilation service cdhash functions.
Monitor selector 0x1b returning the key pointer or NULL; native returns the kernel copy.
Returns KERN_NOT_SUPPORTED (0x2e) when the monitor is disabled, else proc_require, proc task, its pmap and the monitor entitlements; native without a monitor returns KERN_NOT_SUPPORTED.
Registers a provisioning profile with the monitor for the blob (csb_csm_obj, 0xe82b) and returns 0 when unsupported; native without a monitor returns 0.
Tail-calls vm_map_copyin_internal with flags from src_destroy (Darwin 26 adds flag 0x100 that the internal function owns); same arguments as native vm_map_copyin.

Darwin 26 KPI: returns cs_blob+0x58 (the cdhash) and stores the cdhash length byte from +0x98; AMFI uses that length (<= 64) to format and compare cdhashes. Name chosen here; darwin26-kpi.patch returns CS_CDHASH_LEN.

Darwin 26 KPI: (proc, buffer, uint8_t *length) returns EINVAL for kernproc, the vn_getcdhash error, ERANGE when *length is too small, else stores the length and copies the cdhash. Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch.

Darwin 26 KPI: query_trust_cache(type, cdhash, length, token); its neighbour with the length fixed at 0x14 is the plain query. Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch (other lengths are not found).
Darwin 26 KPI: query_trust_cache_for_rem(cdhash, length, rem_perms); its neighbour fixes the length at 0x14. Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch.
Darwin 26 KPI: passes a 64-byte cdhash with its length at +0x40 to the compilation service setter that the 20-byte variant also uses. Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch.
Darwin 26 KPI: the matching variant taking the 64-byte cdhash with its length at +0x40. Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch.

Darwin 26 KPI: monitor selector 0x1c with a 64-byte cdhash and its length at +0x40; the 20-byte variant follows it. Name chosen here; implemented in darwin26-kpi.patch (no-op without a monitor, like native).

Between vfs_vnodecovered and vfs_setdevvp as in kpi_vfs.c: loads mnt_vnodecovered at +0x38 (signed with "mount.mnt_vnodecovered", 0x7e60, which is why the matcher missed it), returns it when the call that follows vnode_get (vnode_getwithref_noblock) returns 0, else NULL. Between get_threadtask_early and current_thread_aborted as in bsd_kern.c: returns the bool at task+0x412, the byte task_pidsuspend sets and clears in the 27 kernel (task->pidsuspended). No symbol in the original image; IOHIDFamily calls it.

Calls setDescriptorID (getKernelReserved, then the atomic ID assignment) and returns reserved->descriptorID, or 0 (kIODescriptorIDInvalid) without reserved data, as IOMemoryDescriptor::getDescriptorID in IOMemoryDescriptor.cpp. No symbol in the original image; IOSurface calls it on its memory descriptor.

sites_note: 2026-11-05 session-52: the recon-staged stack-shift site references _unixnu_kernel_stack_shift, a symbol defined by the sheng board patch zzzz-sheng-ipados27-bringup.patch that this lane does not carry (upstream-minimal series, six we-only patches retired); the site is re-derived only if the first boot actually trips the AMFI entitlements stack check (sheng-proven wall: sp & ((1 << *slot) - 1) < 0x80 false errors on a 4 KiB kernel). The retired entries: [{"site": "0xfffffe0008136458", "native_symbol": "_unixnu_kernel_stack_shift", "evidence": "AppleMobileFileIntegrity's GOT slot for PAGE_SHIFT_CONST. Its only reader is the CoreEntitlements DER iterator's stack check (sp & ((1 << *slot) - 1) < 0x80 returns error 2), which assumes the stack base is aligned to 1 << shift, as on 16 KiB-page Apple kernels where the two lower guard pages are 32 KiB. On the native 4 KiB kernel the stack starts 8 KiB into a 32 KiB-aligned allocation, so the page shift (and 14) give false out-of-stack errors at fixed call depths (OSEntitlements copyDictionary failed with 14 on the exec path). Bound to unixnu_kernel_stack_shift, the allocation alignment shift (15), for which sp & mask stays at least 8 KiB inside any stack. The other ~70 components keep PAGE_SHIFT_CONST for page arithmetic."}]
